# Bundled DuckDB extension

`duckdb-wasm/v1.4.3/wasm_mvp/parquet.duckdb_extension.wasm` is the signed
official Parquet extension mirrored from:

https://extensions.duckdb.org/v1.4.3/wasm_mvp/parquet.duckdb_extension.wasm

It is distributed under DuckDB's MIT License and is bundled so local Parquet
imports do not contact an external extension repository at runtime.
